clips.title: The story
paras: Starbreeze Village is an abandoned night elf settlement situated east of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. Once a tranquil woodland hamlet, it has recently fallen to the maddened furbolgs of the Gnarlpine tribe. The ruined settlement now stands as a glaring symbol of the growing corruption seeping into the roots of the World Tree.

Located southeast of Shadowglen and just down the road from Dolanaar, Starbreeze Village was once home to peaceful night elf families living beneath the boughs of Teldrassil. Today, the village lies in shambles, its wooden structures overrun by aggressive Gnarlpine furbolgs. Driven wild by a sinister corruption afflicting the boughs of the World Tree, the beast-men drove the elven residents out and now defend the ruined grounds ferociously.
